channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Vaping and lung cancer: Here's what we know (and what we don't)
item.description: The long-term relationship between vaping and lung cancer remains uncertain, but existing evidence provides important distinctions between e-cigarettes and combustible tobacco. (Published on November 18, 2026byacsh.org)

item.title: cigarette flavours – regulating flavours via product names
item.description: Ireland has approved new restrictions on e-cigarette flavours, effectively permitting only tobacco-flavoured and unflavoured products through rules governing product names and descriptions. (Published on November 18, 2026byvejpkollen.se)

item.title: Smoking rate falls below 6% for first time, daily vaping declines slightly
item.description: New Zealand's daily smoking rate has fallen below 6% for the first time, reaching 5.9% in the latest national health survey, down from 6.7% the previous year. Daily vaping also declined slightly, from 11.7% to 11.2%. (Published on November 19, 2026bynzherald.co.nz)

item.title: How Japan Halved Cigarette Sales and What It Means for the Rest of the World [Position Paper]
item.description: Japan's cigarette sales fell by 52.6% per capita between 2011 and 2023, with the decline accelerating following the nationwide introduction of heated tobacco products in 2016. (Published on November 19, 2026bypathtosmokefree.global)
